title: Explicit canonical Kunneth route for proper supports
statement: For finite commutative A and a cartesian square p:W→X, q:W→Y, f:X→S, g:Y→S, with f,g,q,h proper and q;g=h, construct the isomorphism Rh!(p*E⊗q*K)≅Rf!E⊗Rg!K as follows: transport the specified compact-support compositor along q;g=h; apply Rg! to inverse q-projection followed by inverse proper exchange tensored with K and the canonical swap; apply inverse g-projection; finally swap the output factors. All maps are the existing concrete maps underlying [def-sf-supported-diagonal-calculus], and the swap is the canonical signed symmetry [lem-kun-tensor-sym]. Generic supportedTensorSwapIso, properRouteCompIso, properRouteProjection and properRouteExchange expose the components of these actual maps. There is no equality-of-routes or Kunneth theorem in the data.

source.place: First supported coordinate extraction before a trace; the coordinate triangle computation before applying its scalar trace

proof.text: Compose the displayed constructed isomorphisms. Properness supplies quasi-compactness and canonical exchange invertibility. Projection is the existing projectionIso, exchange is the existing rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap wrapped componentwise as an isomorphism, composition is the existing specified compactification compositor conjugated by its equality isomorphism, and the swap is the component of derivedTensorSymmetry. Each object and each morphism is written explicitly; each inverse is uniquely determined by its specified forward map, and no arbitrary witness of mere existence supplies data. The component equations and swap naturality are rfl and naturality of the already constructed bifunctor symmetry.

proof_origin.place: First triangle, canonical mixed-counit transpose and proper forget-supports transport

def properSupportedKunnethRoute {S X Y W : Scheme.{u}}
    {p : W ⟶ X} {q : W ⟶ Y} {f : X ⟶ S} {g : Y ⟶ S}
    (sq : IsPullback p q f g) (h : W ⟶ S) (w : q ≫ g = h)
    [IsProper f] [IsProper g] [IsProper q] [IsProper h]
    (E : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) :
    (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).obj
        (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) W).obj
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).leftDerivedFunctor.obj E)).obj
            ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K)) ≅
      ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) S).obj
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).obj E)).obj
          ((rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).obj K)
